data_quality_gate.disclosure: The defect was found during error analysis of the earlier test evaluation. The gate is the pre-existing runtime rule and was not tuned on test data; the threshold was re-selected on validation only and the test set was scored once afterwards.
data_quality_gate.reason: The original extraction accepted any single detected face; in crowded scenes this was sometimes a ~20 px background bystander instead of the subject.
data_quality_gate.rule: faceguard.pipeline.face_quality_reason with the unchanged configs/runtime.yaml thresholds (detection >= 0.6, face side >= 80 px, brightness 40-215, Laplacian variance >= 40)

score_unit: one open-set gallery search per validation probe
